text: This is a very nice lazy-susan, but the one I received seems to .... This is a very nice lazy-susan, but the one I received seems to be a returned item that was not inspected upon return. It had what appears to be, dried frosting between the small and large glass disks and along the edges of the large disk.  Took a while to get a washcloth between the 2 pieces of glass and scrub it all off.  Once it was clean, I love it.
